# Copilot Instructions

This is a Docker learning repository containing educational notes and examples.

## Project Structure

- `Docker/Docker_notes.txt` - Portuguese language study notes covering Docker concepts, installation, and command-line usage

## Context

This repository is **educational in nature**, documenting Docker fundamentals including:
- Container concepts and architecture
- Docker CLI commands and their usage
- Container lifecycle management (run, stop, start, rm)
- Environment variables and port mapping
- File operations between host and containers
- Database container setup examples (MySQL, MariaDB, Debian)

## Key Conventions

- **Language**: Notes and documentation are in Portuguese
- **Format**: Plain text with organized sections using comment headers (`#`)
- **Focus**: Practical command examples with explanations rather than theoretical concepts
- **Use Case**: Reference material for learning Docker, not a production application

## When Assisting

- Treat requests as learning/documentation needs, not production code changes
- Explain Docker concepts clearly when extending documentation
- Maintain Portuguese language in existing content when editing
- Focus on practical, command-based examples consistent with existing notes
- Reference official Docker documentation (hub.docker.com, Docker CLI docs) when appropriate

## No Build/Test Workflows

This repository contains no CI/CD, build scripts, or automated tests. Changes are documentation-only.
